# GMEOW Lexicon Module

The GMEOW Lexicon Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/lexicon>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/lexicon`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

Lexical items, forms, usage attestations, and etymological
    derivations — the lexical and constructional layer of GMEOW. Models words,
    morphemes, phrases, idioms, symbols, and constructions as first-class
    information objects, with concrete forms (written, spoken, signed,
    reconstructed, transliterated, translated) and evidence-backed attestations.
    Etymology is modeled as a graph of provenance-rich, standpointed claims,
    not as a flat origin string (Principle 9). Aligns to OntoLex-Lemon by
    reference (Principle 5). Builds on the language-state/variety layer in
    #170 and the universal observation stack (#43).

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/lexicon>
